title: Finally saw a phone
content: Last night I was having a conversation with someone in the burbs about phones. As far as I know, no one I’ve seen in Mallworld has a phone. They pulled it out like “look I have a dumb phone!” and it was one of those old verizon flip phones from 2005ish. I’ve been on a computer in mall world before but don’t really remember what I was doing. a little backstory: I’ve been going to “mallworld” since I was about 19 and I’m almost 32 now. I’d say I have these dreams 7 out of 7 days of the week. Some more vivid others I’m literally just chillin with friends I’ve met there. haven’t really been able to put my dreams into words until recently. This sub definitely helps. When I tell people I go into an entire dream-world when I sleep, they’re usually just like “wow that’s crazy” or they talk about how they don’t dream much or have a dream world. Real life has been stressful for years and there are times where I’ve taken naps just to go back to mallworld. I’m still kind of shook it’s not just me. Some of these posts describe so accurately it’s almost creepy. I’ve traveled a lot and lived a lot of different places so I used to wonder if that was part of it. I also wonder if I’ll find out more when I die. My neighbor died of an overdose in 2022 and I’ve seen here there, looking healthy. A year before she died she looked already dead inside from the drugs. It was nice to see her in my dreams. Anyways, thanks for reading and maybe I’ll see some of you tonight.
